briefs.label: Sally's August brief (the ~700-word paste that fell to couldnt_apply)
briefs.text: Hi Sprigly! The Navy Edit launches on 28th August at 7pm. Weekend Style Guide every Friday in August: 7th — Maggie t-shirt grey marl; 14th — Lily tee and Sophie short co-ord; 21st — Emily sweatshirt in Midnight; 28th — Hannah t-shirt Navy; and 4th September — Orla long sleeve. A new mini-series starting early August, one post every three weeks, on What I am most proud of. On the 14th the stock leaves the factory for our next drop. On the 15th our factory in Portugal starts its annual summer shutdown. A throwback post using the video of Sally fitting the pre-production long sleeve, given the heatwave. In the Navy Edit build-up, a colour-reveal post asking who can guess the main colour, on the 25th. Also a post on the 26th asking who can guess which of the girls is wearing the navy. At some point a breakdown of how our sweatshirts are made. We should talk more about how life is busy and clothes should be simple. More on our organic cotton staples in general. A theme about the simple things that just work. And the fact that we never use polyester. When you get a sec, pull the DMs from last week and let me know the good ones. Thanks so much, Sally x
